en.text:
Kills grant one stack of 'Gun And Run' for 10 (#e 11) seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks. If the buff expires, the next kill will grant however many stacks were previously held.

After sprinting for 0.75 seconds without a full magazine, consume one stack and <title refill [G_refill] /> 25% magazine capacity every 0.85 seconds.

For bows, this trait instead grants a 15% Faster Draw Time for ? seconds.

Provides no benefit to Swords.
